data.narrative:
Skydio, a Series F autonomous systems company in Defense & Security, carries a current post-money valuation of $4.4B following $825M+ in total capital raised. The valuation is assessed against a comp universe of 16 same-sector peers at similar valuation tiers, comprising 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies including Anduril Industries, Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), Shield AI ($12.7B, Series G), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.3x step-up multiplier typical of Series F to subsequent-stage transitions against the $4.4B base, implying $5.7B. Peer-median analysis across the 16-company comp set yields a median valuation of $2.2B, with a range spanning $1.0B to $18.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion within the Defense & Security frontier-tech segment.

The triangulated analysis—combining both methods—supports a valuation range of $1.8B (low) to $6.6B (high), with a median of $3.9B. The current $4.4B valuation sits above the triangulated median but within the range. Key uncertainties include revenue visibility and customer concentration within the defense contractor ecosystem, as well as the substantial variance across peer valuations, which suggests stage and funding environment heterogeneity within the comp set.
